name: Ochakai e no Shoutaijou
source:
"You know, there is an old tale of love told in this city—"

Early 20th century, England.
An era when the world was rapidly changing, from the old age into the new.
I’ll probably never leave the countryside my whole life—and there’s no need to.
Fashion just gets in the way of harvesting, and if I’m going to learn anything, it’s better to learn farm work than follow trends.
Donna, who was born and raised on a rural farm, had no interest in trends or fashion, and once again devoted herself to her work on the farm today.
However, when her grandmother—who lived in the city—passed away, an emergency disrupted her peaceful country life.
Ordered to sort through her grandmother’s belongings, she left the countryside and headed to the city.
Her first time ever in the great metropolis of London.
The task of organizing the belongings, which she accepted reluctantly.
Filled with both anticipation and anxiety toward the unfamiliar city, the doorbell suddenly rang
Beyond the door stood unfamiliar gentlemen, said to have been guests at her grandmother’s tea parties.
Was it only joyful tea parties that her grandmother—once known as a celebrated beauty of London’s high society—left behind…?

[Translated from the [url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/adventure/game_4471.html]Freegame Mugen[/url]]
translation:
“你知道吗，这座城市流传着一个古老的爱情故事——”

二十世纪初，英国。
世界正从旧时代向新时代飞速转变。
我大概一辈子都不会离开乡下——也没必要离开。
时髦衣服只会碍着收割。真要学点什么，学农活也比追赶潮流有用。
唐娜在乡间农场出生、长大，对流行与时尚毫无兴趣，今天也一如既往地埋头干活。
然而，住在城里的祖母去世，一场突如其来的变故打破了她宁静的乡村生活。
受命整理祖母遗物，她离开乡下，前往城市。
这是她第一次来到大都市伦敦。
整理遗物的差事，她接得并不情愿。
对陌生城市既期待又不安时，门铃忽然响起。
门外站着几位素不相识的绅士，据说都是祖母茶会上的常客。
祖母曾是伦敦上流社会闻名的美人，她留下的，难道只有欢乐的茶会吗……？
